_help: Maps the app's controls onto nodes in workflow_api.json (the 'MiniMax - RefMod' workflow from the Hearmeman template).
A node is found either by ID ({ "node": "173" }) or by what it is ({ "find": { "class_type": "..." } } or { "find": { "title": "..." } }).
Selectors keep working if the template renumbers its nodes. Run `npm run inspect` to list every node in your workflow.
Remove a section the workflow doesn't have. Other workflows can use `loras` (separate loader nodes), `negativePrompt`, `referenceImages` and `referenceVideos`.
title: MiniMax H3 · RefMod
